items.title: Self-Evolving Search Index
items.summary: 提出 SELF-INDEX，使检索索引能根据检索环境自我演进。

items.title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing

items.why: 偏向具身智能评估，与底层优化或生成模型关联较弱。

items.title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
